name: JOS-Animation-Library
description: A fullblown in-house animation library that can add instant scroll animation to all elements in your website, making it look beautiful & professional. Comes with tons of customization options but is still easy to use, all in a small footprint

paragraphs: JOS-Animation, Javascript On Scroll Animation library is a simple & easy to use animation library package to instantly add professional animation to your website. It was built to make my life easier while developing websites & comes with tons of features and is fully customizable. It is lightweight & has a very small footprint. The best part of all is that it has no (\minimum) toll on performance.
This project is currently being developed by me & the dev community, So you can expect more features and updates quite often..
Was inspired by GSAP, AOS libraries. I wanted something easier to use, with great performance and wanted to make the implementation better. So I worked on this project from scratch.
features: Includes Preset and expert custom animation options.
Works with all major browsers & Platforms.
Fast, light and small with no/min toll on performance.
Simple & easy to setup for both beginners & experts.
Customize animation settings and build your own scroll invoked functions
